data: Which of the red points on the line correspond to a window size greater than 5?

The red points on the line represent the F1 score for different window sizes. The x-axis represents the window size in hours, and the y-axis represents the F1 score. The red points are labeled with their corresponding window sizes. To determine which red points correspond to a window size greater than 5, we need to look at the x-axis values of the red points. The red points labeled with 6(h), 10(h), and 20(h) have x-axis values greater than 5. Therefore, the red points corresponding to a window size greater than 5 are those labeled with 6(h), 10(h), and 20(h).
